# `aube store add`

- **Usage:** `aube store add <PACKAGES>…`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Add one or more packages to the global store without linking them into any project.

Each argument is a package spec: `lodash`, `lodash@4.17.21`, `react@next`, or `express@^4`.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube store add react@19.1.0
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-modules) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<PACKAGES>…`** — Package specs to fetch into the store.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
